title: [submission] Kalshi weather index archive (minute temperature index, hourly since 2026-09-03, CC BY 4.0)
body:
### Link

https://apify.com/gratified_ashram/kalshi-weather-index#free-public-archive-cc-by-40

Direct data: https://api.apify.com/v2/datasets/sBYy8Bm1pgdPsfvRd/items?format=csv&clean=true (JSON with `format=json`)

### What is it

Dataset - history you can backtest on

### Which venues does it cover

kalshi

### What does it do, and why does it beat what's already listed

Rolling archive of the minute-level temperature index Kalshi publishes for its hourly temperature markets (KXTEMP*, ten cities), collected hourly since 2026-09-03. Kalshi's own endpoint only serves the last 7–10 days, so this is the only place to get the settlement series further back. One row per complete city-hour (no duplicates) with all 60 minute values, min/max and the calibration version. Free, no account needed, CC BY 4.0. Grows by ~240 rows a day; young, so say so in the entry.

### Is this yours

- [x] I made this, or I work on it.
